scope: First-depth i386 SafeLoadLibrary selector in host_def.h
product_evidence: Actual x86 worker nt_bop.c command compiled an isolated copy with an inserted marker immediately before host_def.h, and reported i386 undefined.
The earlier context audit found 592 matching product compile commands with no explicit i386 flag; no i386 macro definition was found in current src or MSVC/Windows SDK headers scanned.
decision: Pending: historical tool-generated test profiles explicitly use /Di386, and their complete inclusion closure/applicability has not been established. Do not replace this branch from product evidence alone.
limitations: The BOP probe is one actual context, not proof for all possible supported test contexts.
The legacy trace fixture defines SafeLoadLibrary, but its referenced historical graph has missing paths.
